scope: Read-only interface research for cold LPDDR4 reset, CKE and host transaction ownership. No hardware execution, opaque sequencer descriptors, firmware or vendor executable imports.

independent_old_generation_reference.nxp: zephyrproject-rtos/hal_nxp e07b15c3eceae2f853db5c1308c23db6b30c6f20 mcux/mcux-sdk-ng/devices/i.MX/i.MX91/periph/PERI_DWC_DDRPHYA_MASTER.h, blob01ae82c65ddad6df749185b1af35992a96ed021a. This is an older generation and is auxiliary evidence only.
independent_old_generation_reference.limits: The current Type9 master map differs at known registers. Matching offsets do not authorize transplanting complete fields or pin layouts.

reset.independent_name: MemResetL; older named fields bit0 MemResetLValue and bit1 ProtectMemReset
reset.public_target_direct_access: InfernoEmbedded/u-boot2f5e45fa7993ce8a4a59b638e539a06d8454f823 dwc_ddrphy_pmu_regs.h348 calls it PHY_REG_PHY_STATUS; pmu_train.c1556 writes2 and pmu_eye.c2808 writes3 with waits around the transition, optionally writing1 at2812.
reset.candidate: A source-measured2->3 transition has same-SoC public direct-CSR precedent. It does not establish physical CKE, clock stability or ownership of DRAM command pins.
reset.physical_waits: Preserve JEDEC reset-low minimum200us after supplies, reset-high to CKE minimum2ms, clock stable at least5cycles before CKE and CKE-high to commands minimum2us. Public helper delay constants are scaled values, not literal microseconds.

transaction_mux.correction: Do not use logical20061 as PUBMODE; that earlier tentative association was incorrect.
transaction_mux.old_generation_definition: NXP PUBMODE register offset0xdc: HwtMemSrc bit0=1 switches the memory-transaction source mux from DCT to HWT. ST independently names logical6e and bit0.
transaction_mux.target_access_fact: Public target header names900400dc PHY_REG_MASTER_CAL_CTRL; pmu_train.c1395 writes1. The macro's calibration name is not authoritative.
transaction_mux.status: Candidate cross-generation correlation; no independently named Type9 PubMode/HwtMemSrc field was found. No direct write or handoff is implemented by this audit.

direct_control.type9_confirmed_name: SiMa-ai/sima-ai-uboot5a026adbe2a54aeaae5dc50e1852d4b5c1884640 init_ddr_modalix.c independently labels logical2007e HwtControlVal. Host presets are33 for two ranks and11 for one rank. These values do not establish individual pin fields.
direct_control.target_direct_access: Public pmu_telemetry.c pmu_ac_lane_profile_setup saves900400f4 and900400fc via halfword reads, writes Val0 then Ovrff, performs analog configuration and restores both saved values. Those ordinary direct registers are separate from sequencer memory.
direct_control.old_generation_fields: ST logical7a HwtControlOvr0 and7e HwtControlVal0 have CS0..3 bits0..3, CKE0..3 bits4..7, ODT0..3 bits8..11 and parity bit12. A second DFI register exists at7b/7f. NXP identifies the pair as overriding ACSM outputs for DFI0/1, but leaves full13-bit fields RFU.
direct_control.critical_limit: Type9 SiMa names one combined HwtControlVal without suffix0/1. The older CS/CKE field layout must not be treated as established for the target.33/11 are compatible with more than one pin/rank interpretation.
direct_control.read_observation_value: A future source-held raw snapshot of0dc/0f4/0fc/012/0e4/0e6 could characterize a checkpoint, subject to hardware-owner review. Readback alone would not establish pin state or a working clock.

separation_from_sequence_generation.strobe_init: Public pmu_cal_strobe_pulse_init at pmu_clock.c129 only clears two descriptor positions and software markers; it does not itself drive CKE.
separation_from_sequence_generation.ownership: ACSM command encoding and permitted source-authored sequences are investigated separately. No sequencer array or opaque descriptor has been translated in this audit.
separation_from_sequence_generation.dfi_complete: No transferable Type9 DfiInitComplete output control address/mask is established. The older logical200f9 and shadowd00fa addresses must not be transplanted or forced solely to satisfy a controller status check.
